sequences.query:
activity_type:"process_create" AND ( process_command_line:RGXi("(/root/)?\\.ssh/authorized_keys")
OR process_command_line:RGXi("(/root/)?\\.ssh/authorized_keys\\.") ) AND ( process_command_line:RGXi("rm ")  OR process_command_line:RGXi("mv ")  OR process_command_line:RGXi("cp ")  OR process_command_line:RGXi(">>")  OR process_command_line:RGXi("> ")  OR process_command_line:RGXi("tee ")  OR process_command_line:RGXi("sed ")  OR process_command_line:RGXi("truncate ")  OR process_command_line:RGXi("chmod ")  OR process_command_line:RGXi("chown ")  OR process_command_line:RGXi("vi ")  OR process_command_line:RGXi("vim ")  OR process_command_line:RGXi("nano ")) AND NOT process_name:("cat","grep","ls","stat")
